  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const container = document.getElementById("scene");
    const loading = document.getElementById("loading");

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Renderer, scene and camera
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.05;
    container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x8bc8d2, 38, 118);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      43,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      180
    );

    const cameraState = {
      target: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.35, 0),
      radius: 11.4,
      theta: 0.78,
      phi: 1.04
    };

    function updateCamera() {
      const { target, radius, theta, phi } = cameraState;
      const sinPhi = Math.sin(phi);

      camera.position.set(
        target.x + radius * sinPhi * Math.sin(theta),
        target.y + radius * Math.cos(phi),
        target.z + radius * sinPhi * Math.cos(theta)
      );

      camera.lookAt(target);
    }

    updateCamera();

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Lighting
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xbdefff, 0x17363b, 2.0);
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff2cf, 3.25);
    sun.position.set(12, 22, 10);
    sun.castShadow = true;
    sun.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    sun.shadow.camera.left = -12;
    sun.shadow.camera.right = 12;
    sun.shadow.camera.top = 12;
    sun.shadow.camera.bottom = -12;
    sun.shadow.camera.near = 1;
    sun.shadow.camera.far = 45;
    sun.shadow.bias = -0.00035;
    scene.add(sun);

    const rimLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x65c9e8, 1.15);
    rimLight.position.set(-10, 8, -12);
    scene.add(rimLight);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Materials
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const materials = {
      hull: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x176a88,
        metalness: 0.32,
        roughness: 0.36
      }),
      hullDark: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x103d50,
        metalness: 0.4,
        roughness: 0.4
      }),
      deck: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x34464a,
        metalness: 0.18,
        roughness: 0.82
      }),
      white: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xe7eef0,
        metalness: 0.12,
        roughness: 0.48
      }),
      yellow: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xf2b82f,
        metalness: 0.35,
        roughness: 0.34
      }),
      orange: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xf57824,
        metalness: 0.12,
        roughness: 0.48
      }),
      black: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x111a1d,
        metalness: 0.18,
        roughness: 0.65
      }),
      metal: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x9ba9ad,
        metalness: 0.8,
        roughness: 0.3
      }),
      glass: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x173b49,
        metalness: 0.65,
        roughness: 0.12
      }),
      rubber: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x172124,
        roughness: 0.9
      }),
      red: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xff3038,
        emissive: 0x7b0000,
        emissiveIntensity: 1.2,
        roughness: 0.35
      }),
      green: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x38ff78,
        emissive: 0x007a35,
        emissiveIntensity: 1.2,
        roughness: 0.35
      }),
      lamp: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xfff3bd,
        emissive: 0xffd36a,
        emissiveIntensity: 2.2,
        roughness: 0.25
      })
    };

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Geometry helpers
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    function addBox(parent, w, h, d, x, y, z, material) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d),
        material
      );
      mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function addCylinder(
      parent,
      radiusTop,
      radiusBottom,
      height,
      x,
      y,
      z,
      material,
      segments = 16
    ) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
          radiusTop,
          radiusBottom,
          height,
          segments
        ),
        material
      );
      mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function cylinderBetween(parent, a, b, radius, material, segments = 8) {
      const start = new THREE.Vector3(...a);
      const end = new THREE.Vector3(...b);
      const direction = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(end, start);
      const length = direction.length();

      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius, radius, length, segments),
        material
      );

      mesh.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
        direction.clone().normalize()
      );

      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function addRailing(parent, points) {
      for (let i = 0; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
        const a = new THREE.Vector3(...points[i]);
        const b = new THREE.Vector3(...points[i + 1]);
        const horizontal = new THREE.Vector3(
          b.x - a.x,
          0,
          b.z - a.z
        );
        const length = horizontal.length();

        const topA = a.clone();
        const topB = b.clone();
        const lowA = a.clone();
        const lowB = b.clone();

        topA.y += 0.78;
        topB.y += 0.78;
        lowA.y += 0.38;
        lowB.y += 0.38;

        cylinderBetween(parent, topA.toArray(), topB.toArray(), 0.035, materials.metal);
        cylinderBetween(parent, lowA.toArray(), lowB.toArray(), 0.025, materials.metal);

        const count = Math.max(2, Math.ceil(length / 0.75));
        for (let j = 0; j <= count; j++) {
          const point = a.clone().lerp(b, j / count);
          cylinderBetween(
            parent,
            point.toArray(),
            point.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.78, 0)).toArray(),
            0.035,
            materials.metal
          );
        }
      }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Procedural deck texture
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const deckCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    deckCanvas.width = 512;
    deckCanvas.height = 256;

    const deckContext = deckCanvas.getContext("2d");
    deckContext.fillStyle = "#304145";
    deckContext.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 256);

    for (let x = -256; x < 768; x += 32) {
      for (let y = -256; y < 512; y += 32) {
        deckContext.beginPath();
        deckContext.moveTo(x, y);
        deckContext.lineTo(x + 256, y + 256);
        deckContext.strokeStyle = "rgba(10, 20, 22, 0.34)";
        deckContext.lineWidth = 2;
        deckContext.stroke();
      }
    }

    deckContext.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.035)";
    for (let x = 0; x < 512; x += 64) {
      for (let y = 0; y < 256; y += 64) {
        deckContext.fillRect(x, y, 3, 3);
      }
    }

    const deckTexture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(deckCanvas);
    deckTexture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    deckTexture.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    deckTexture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    deckTexture.repeat.set(2, 1);

    const deckMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      map: deckTexture,
      metalness: 0.2,
      roughness: 0.8
    });

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Sky and water
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const sky = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(100, 32, 18),
      new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
        side: THREE.BackSide,
        depthWrite: false,
        uniforms: {
          topColor: { value: new THREE.Color(0x1b7ca8) },
          horizonColor: { value: new THREE.Color(0x9bcbd3) }
        },
        vertexShader: `
          varying vec3 vWorldPosition;

          void main() {
            vec4 worldPosition = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
            vWorldPosition = worldPosition.xyz;
            gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * worldPosition;
          }
        `,
        fragmentShader: `
          uniform vec3 topColor;
          uniform vec3 horizonColor;
          varying vec3 vWorldPosition;

          void main() {
            float height = normalize(vWorldPosition).y;
            float blend = smoothstep(-0.12, 0.72, height);
            vec3 color = mix(horizonColor, topColor, blend);

            vec3 sunDirection = normalize(vec3(0.45, 0.65, 0.4));
            float glow = pow(max(dot(normalize(vWorldPosition), sunDirection), 0.0), 180.0);
            color += vec3(1.0, 0.72, 0.38) * glow * 0.55;

            gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
          }
        `
      })
    );
    scene.add(sky);

    const waterGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(120, 120, 90, 90);
    waterGeometry.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);

    const waterMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x0b6170,
      metalness: 0.38,
      roughness: 0.28,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.96
    });

    const water = new THREE.Mesh(waterGeometry, waterMaterial);
    water.position.y = 0;
    water.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(water);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Buoy tender hull
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    const tender = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(tender);

    const hullShape = new THREE.Shape();
    hullShape.moveTo(-3.55, -0.56);
    hullShape.lineTo(-3.35, 0.72);
    hullShape.lineTo(2.55, 0.72);
    hullShape.lineTo(3.15, 0.04);
    hullShape.lineTo(2.45, -0.58);
    hullShape.lineTo(-3.55, -0.56);
    hullShape.closePath();

    const hullGeometry = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(hullShape, {
      depth: 2.08,
      bevelEnabled: true,
      bevelSegments: 3,
      bevelSize: 0.16,
      bevelThickness: 0.16,
      curveSegments: 8
    });
    hullGeometry.translate(0, 0, -1.04);

    const hull = new THREE.Mesh(hullGeometry, materials.hull);
    hull.castShadow = true;
    hull.receiveShadow = true;
    tender.add(hull);

    addBox(tender, 5.85, 0.12, 2.04, -0.2, 0.91, 0, materials.deck);

    // White hull stripe.
    addBox(tender, 5.7, 0.1, 0.035, -0.15, 0.18, 1.075, materials.white);
    addBox(tender, 5.7, 0.1, 0.035, -0.15, 0.18, -1.075, materials.white);

    // Dark rubbing strake.
    addBox(tender, 5.55, 0.12, 0.055, -0.15, 0.94, 1.08, materials.black);
    addBox(tender, 5.55, 0.12, 0.055, -0.15, 0.94, -1.08, materials.black);

    // Deckhouse.
    addBox(tender, 2.65, 1.48, 1.96, 1.03, 1.55, 0, materials.white);
    addBox(tender, 2.82, 0.13, 2.14, 1.03, 2.34, 0, materials.hullDark);
    addBox(tender, 2.42, 0.12, 1.78, 1.03, 2.44, 0, materials.white);

    // Windshield and side windows.
    addBox(tender, 0.055, 0.66, 1.58, 2.37, 1.77, 0, materials.glass);
    addBox(tender, 0.92, 0.48, 0.055, 0.82, 1.82, 0.995, materials.glass);
    addBox(tender, 0.92, 0.48, 0.055, 0.82, 1.82, -0.995, materials.glass);

    // Door and handle.
    addBox(tender, 0.66, 1.05, 0.055, 1.55, 1.48, 1.005, materials.hullDark);
    addBox(tender, 0.045, 0.22, 0.05, 1.8, 1.52, 1.04, materials.metal);

    // Roof equipment.
    addBox(tender, 0.72, 0.18, 0.52, 0.15, 2.58, 0, materials.metal);
    addCylinder(tender, 0.16, 0.19, 0.34, -0.45, 2.6, 0, materials.white);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Working deck details
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    // Railings leave the crane and center deck clear.
    addRailing(tender, [
      [-3.25, -0.96],
      [-1.05, -0.96],
      [-0.85, -0.96],
      [0.68, -0.96],
      [0.68, 0.96],
      [-3.25, 0.96],
      [-3.25, 0.42],
      [-3.25, -0.42]
    ]);

    // Bollards.
    function addBollard(x, z) {
      addCylinder(tender, 0.1, 0.14, 0.25, x, 1.1, z, materials.metal);
      addCylinder(tender, 0.15, 0.15, 0.08, x, 1.26, z, materials.metal);
      addCylinder(tender, 0.09, 0.09, 0.08, x, 1.35, z, materials.metal);
    }

    addBollard(0.65, 0.86);
    addBollard(0.65, -0.86);
    addBollard(-0.8, 0.86);
    addBollard(-0.8, -0.86);

    // Winch.
    addBox(tender, 1.05, 0.18, 0.58, 0.2, 1.08, -0.42, materials.hullDark);
    addCylinder(tender, 0.22, 0.22, 0.8, 0.2, 1.27, -0.42, materials.metal);
    addCylinder(tender, 0.24, 0.24, 0.08, 0.2, 1.27, -0.82, materials.black);
    addCylinder(tender, 0.24, 0.24, 0.08, 0.2, 1.27, -0.02, materials.black);

    // Anchor.
    const anchor = new THREE.Group();
    anchor.position.set(-3.43, 1.02, 0);
    tender.add(anchor);

    addBox(anchor, 0.28, 0.08, 0.08, 0, 0, 0, materials.metal);
    addBox(anchor, 0.08, 0.48, 0.08, 0, 0.2, 0, materials.metal);
    addBox(anchor, 0.4, 0.08, 0.08, 0, 0.42, 0, materials.metal);
    addBox(anchor, 0.08, 0.32, 0.08, 0, 0.58, 0, materials.metal);

    // Fenders.
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      for (const x of [-2.55, -0.9, 0.75]) {
        const fender = addCylinder(
          tender,
          0.13,
          0.15,
          0.34,
          x,
          0.64,
          side * 1.08,
          materials.rubber
        );
        fender.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
      }
    }

    // Life rings.
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const ring = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.28, 0.075, 10, 24),
        materials.orange
      );
      ring.position.set(-0.25, 1.35, side * 1.08);
      ring.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;
      ring.castShadow = true;
      tender.add(ring);

      const band = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.28, 0.018, 6, 24),
        materials.white
      );
      band.position.set(-0.25, 1.35, side * 1.16);
      band.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;
      tender.add(band);
    }

    // Vessel name on both sides.
    const nameCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    nameCanvas.width = 512;
    nameCanvas.height = 128;
    const nameContext = nameCanvas.getContext("2d");
    nameContext.clearRect(0, 0, 512, 128);
    nameContext.fillStyle = "rgba(220,235,238,0.85)";
    nameContext.font = "700 62px sans-serif";
    nameContext.textAlign = "center";
    nameContext.textBaseline = "middle";
    nameContext.fillText("TENDER 07", 256, 67);

    const nameTexture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(nameCanvas);
    nameTexture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;

    const nameMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      map: nameTexture,
      transparent: true,
      depthWrite: false,
